verbatim: 1. **检索覆盖不足**：1,320 条待筛记录只有 660 条进入题名/摘要筛选（50%），其余 660 条因筛选预算上限被截断；另有 66 条记录在检索阶段未取到（PubMed 命中 1,083 条、实际取回 1,000 条，差额 83 条即其中的未取回部分），这两项合计 726 条未进入题名/摘要筛选。进入全文评估的 157 篇报告里有 98 篇没有取得全文。各处未覆盖的口径不同，遗漏相关试验的风险不可忽略。
whyItIsWrong: 83 raw PubMed hits not fetched are described as part of 66 post-dedup not-retrieved records without explaining overlap/deduplication.
note: Keep raw source retrieval and post-dedup PRISMA accounting as distinct denominators; avoid wording that implies 83 is a subset count of 66. Keep the supported artifacts and calculations; correct or qualify the affected statement only. No human approval is required.
